name: Thargelia
summary: The first fruits of early summer and the twins' birthdays kept back to back — Artemis on the sixth, Apollo on the seventh — with the city purified before the offering of the thargelos loaf.
testimonia: Diogenes Laertius 2.44 (Thargelion 6, Artemis' day; the 7th, Apollo's)
Plutarch, Table Talk 8.1.1 (Plato born on Thargelion 7, Apollo's feast)
